parse_halide_expression: parse a Halide expression string like (v0 + v1) into a tree structure using HalideParser
tokenize_halide_input: tokenize a raw Halide expression string using HalideTokenizer preprocess method with pyparsing
schedule_jobs_ejf: schedule job-shop scheduling problem using earliest job first algorithm via jspDependencyParser ejf method
schedule_jobs_sjf: schedule job-shop scheduling problem using shortest job first algorithm via jspDependencyParser sjf method
parse_vrp_problem: parse a vehicle routing problem with depot and customers into a VrpManager using vrpParser
